correctness.rationale: For fixed r, exact disjoint factorial moments of same-parent, same-colour leaf pairs converge to (e^-2/(2alpha))^r; overlapping components of size at least three contribute O(1/n). Nontrivial automorphisms of the cyclic points are ruled out by O(sqrt(n)/q)+O(log(n)/q). After fixing the cycles, any moved nonleaf forces four distinct vertices with two functional and two colour coincidences beyond sibling equality, and expected witness count is at most (n)_4/(n^3 q^2)=o(1). The remaining automorphisms are exactly twin-leaf class permutations, establishing the limiting rigidity probability. A standard-library script was actually run and checks finite exact expectations and small automorphism groups; it does not certify the infinite limit.
